name: Run SFC Scan
description: Runs the Windows System File Checker to scan and repair protected system files that may be missing, damaged, or modified.

description_i18n.en: Runs the Windows System File Checker to scan and repair protected system files that may be missing, damaged, or modified.
description_i18n.de: Führt die Windows-Systemdateiprüfung aus, um geschützte Systemdateien zu scannen und fehlende oder beschädigte Dateien wiederherzustellen.
description_i18n.fr: Lance l’outil de vérification des fichiers système pour analyser et réparer les fichiers protégés manquants ou endommagés.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes the SFC /scannow command to verify system file integrity and replace corrupted files with cached copies from Windows installation media
